panels.title: Inference latency · first token and completion
panels.description: Histogram percentiles with a zoom-adaptive rate window. No value when there are no observations in range.

panels.title: Recent requests · client, result and cost
panels.description: Recent recorded gateway requests. Prompts, IP addresses, constant model aliases and empty trace links are omitted. Use Langfuse for payload investigation.

panels.title: Infrastructure details · throughput, GPU and cache
Output tok/s (total)
panels.description: Live output tok/s while the engine is actively serving (last minute, idle seconds excluded from the denominator). Zoom-independent: the same number at any dashboard range.

panels.title: Decode tok/s / request
panels.description: Reciprocal of mean per-request time per output token over five minutes. Excludes prefill; no value when there are no recent completed requests.

panels.title: Inference throughput — tokens / second
panels.description: Per-point tok/s while actively serving: the rate window is scrape-safe ($__rate_interval) and idle seconds are excluded via the running-request fraction, so zooming out to weeks keeps real workload throughput instead of decaying toward 0. Idle spans show as 0. Stat tiles above are the pure live last-minute rates.

panels.title: Live requests — running / queued
panels.description: Live engine state, including requests that have not completed yet.

panels.title: KV cache / prefix cache hit rate
panels.description: KV occupancy and five-minute token-weighted prefix-cache hit ratio. Hit rate is undefined when no cache queries occurred.

panels.title: RTX PRO 6000 — GPU utilization
panels.description: All activity on the cards, including model loading, startup warm-up and jobs outside LiteLLM. Gaps indicate missing telemetry, not idle GPUs.

panels.title: RTX PRO 6000 — VRAM used
panels.description: Allocated GPU memory, including model weights and KV cache reservations.

panels.title: RTX PRO 6000 — power
panels.description: Board power reported by NVIDIA DCGM.
